config.description: Configuration file tinyproxy is started with (CONFIG, passed as -c via FLAGS). Debian's unit reads this file as its environment; unset = the shipped commented lines, tinyproxy then reads /etc/tinyproxy/tinyproxy.conf.

extra_flags.description: Further tinyproxy command-line options appended to FLAGS (for example -d to stay in the foreground). Unset = none.
